concerns.text: User Story 1 (Data Ingestion and Preprocessing) has functional requirements (FR-001, FR-002) but no success criteria are anchored to it; SC-001‑SC-005 do not reference US‑1.
Success Criterion SC-005 (runtime measurement) is not linked to any user story; it lacks an anchor such as ‘(See US‑2)’ and therefore is an orphaned SC.
FR-001 references “(See US-1)” but no identifier US-1 is defined anywhere in the document. The user stories are titled “User Story 1”, “User Story 2”, etc., without corresponding US‑1, US‑2 IDs.

Inconsistent terminology: the specification uses both “User Story 1” (plain text) and the shorthand “US-1” in cross‑references. This creates ambiguity and breaks traceability between requirements and stories.

The specification requires downloading public AM alloy datasets that include alloy composition, yet the functional requirements and modeling pipeline (FR-003, FR-006) do not describe any strategy to account for alloy composition or other latent confounding variables (e.g., microstructural state). Without controlling or explicitly modeling these confounds, inferred correlations between processing parameters and mechanical properties may be spurious, violating construct validity.

Success Criterion SC-004 proposes measuring the correlation between permutation‑importance rankings and a “user‑provided JSON ranking of expected parameter influence (or a published literature baseline)”. If the user‑provided ranking is derived from the same dataset or model, the validation becomes circular. The spec must require that the reference ranking be independent of the data used to train the GPR model (e.g., from prior literature or separate experiments).

responses.what_changed: Inserted new SC-006 entry under Success Criteria; appended '(See US-2)' to SC-005.

responses.response: Introduced FR-008 to incorporate alloy composition as a covariate and added SC-007 to assess confounding; expanded FR-001 to require alloy composition column.
responses.what_changed: Added FR-008 and SC-007 entries; modified FR-001 to list alloy composition among required fields.

responses.response: Reworded SC-004 to require an independent reference ranking from literature or separate experiments, eliminating circular validation.
responses.what_changed: Edited SC-004 description to specify external independent ranking source.

new_concerns.text: FR-008 currently uses optional language ('optionally perform stratified analysis or include it as a covariate'). To ensure confounding is properly controlled, the inclusion of alloy composition (and any other available microstructural descriptors) should be mandatory, not optional.

responses.response: Added explicit validation of required processing‑parameter and mechanical‑property columns, and introduced a new functional requirement (FR-009) plus a success criterion (SC-008) that mandate modeling alloy composition (and any available microstructural covariates) as confounders. This directly addresses the reviewer’s scientific‑soundness concern about uncontrolled latent variables and ensures construct validity.
responses.what_changed: FR-001 text expanded to require exact column names and reject mismatched datasets; inserted new FR-009 after FR-008; inserted new SC-008 after SC-007; added (See US-2) anchors for the new items.
